narratives.Overview: Add fly.io deployment support using native flyctl multi-container Machines. flyctl v0.3.147+ parses docker-compose.yml natively via [build] compose field; services communicate via localhost with /etc/hosts mapping. fly.io handles TLS at edge; Caddy runs HTTP-only internally. Named volumes replaced with Fly persistent volumes via [[mounts]]. Confirmed by user 2026-04-27T00:28:00Z.
narratives.Architecture: fly.io Machines (not Docker VMs). Multi-container via flyctl compose support. Standalone: fly.toml + docker-compose.fly.yml. Proxy: fly-proxy.toml + docker-compose.fly-proxy.yml. Fly secrets replace .env.
